about: PRODUCT-MAP: what Pulse's repo scan (services/api/src/product-map-scan.ts) cannot read from the code: the roles a signed-in person has (services/api/src/routes.ts Viewer.role, settings Screens and menu) and which roles each word of the shell's `access` field reaches (packages/ui-shell/src/shell.tsx pagesForRole).

roles.name: Team member
roles.description: Staff who do the work: designers, editors, salespeople; chats, tasks, their own desk.

roles.name: Pod manager
roles.description: Leads a pod: the team's work, reviews, people in the pod.

roles.name: Pod growth strategist
roles.description: Runs client growth for a pod: clients, projects, processes.

roles.name: HR
roles.description: HR desk only: people, attendance, leave, policies; never clients, money or admin.

roles.name: Finance
roles.description: Money: billing, invoices, the cash book.

roles.name: Leadership
roles.description: The company's leaders: everything the team sees plus leadership, finance and the network.

roles.name: Organisation admin
roles.description: Sets Pulse up for the organisation: settings, screens, modules, audit.
